verdict.rationale: Statsig ships an official MCP server explicitly designed so AI tools (Codex, Cursor, Claude Code) can 'ask questions, explore experiments, and access your Statsig data,' plus a Console API for CRUD access to experiments and an HTTP API for retrieving gate/experiment values programmatically — together enabling an AI agent to read configs and results and reason about them. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that the MCP/API surfaces detailed experiment results (metric lifts, confidence intervals) rather than just configuration/exploration, and no hands-on/independent report of an agent actually producing ship/rollback recommendations.
